protocol.purpose: Test whether cross-image KC/DAN rate history participates in the extra BUY in the original pulse assay, while preserving other neural state and immediate stimulation. Previously inspected historical inputs; not a held-out trading score.
protocol.hypothesis: Clearing only the active centered-rule rate traces before images 2 and 3 can change online memory updates and the final decoder gate. The frozen-memory reset control must preserve every original spike-count bin because these traces do not feed the neural kernel directly.
protocol.training: Use the same recorded initial trained weights/u/w from pulse study 01, verifying the original memory signature. Every arm starts with fresh native dynamics and zero KC/DAN rate traces.
protocol.inputs: Exactly the same three sealed market images as pulse study 01. Verify image hashes and retain the original none/aversive/reward pulse sequence in recorded-pulse arms regardless of counterfactual neural actions.
protocol.execution_order: All three carry controls and their full-bin reference checks complete before any reset condition. Publish every condition in the declared order.
validation: Verify the full 166700-neuron, 25582938-edge graph, unchanged native source/binary identity and 7835 plastic edges.
Original carry controls reproduce all 50 bins of all 166700 neuron counts for each of their three images, plus recorded weights/u/w and rate traces.
At each boundary save all before/after dynamic arrays and memory, verify only declared rate arrays change, and retain original clock and all weights.
The first image of every reset arm reproduces its carry control before intervention.
The frozen reset arm reproduces all three full spike-count recordings and preserves weights/u/w despite rate-trace changes.
Independently audit saved whole-network counts, fixed decoder outputs, memory updates and all boundary arrays before interpreting results.
outcomes: Every decoded action and gate/direction count
protocol.interpretation: Mechanism experiment only. A removed BUY is not automatically a correct trade; no account, fill, return or policy selection is recomputed. Trace removal changes future activity through online memory updates, so the offline algebraic split does not predict its causal effect.
protocol.recovery: Write and retain one submission receipt before calling Modal; after an observation timeout reattach that exact call. Do not clear an owning lease or create another run unless authoritative state resolves the original call.
